An absolute behemoth of a survival game that fulfills every gamer's ultimate fantasy: taming and riding massive dinosaurs. You wake up naked on a mysterious sci-fi island and must hunt, harvest, craft, and build your way up from stone-age tools to high-tech lasers. The sense of scale and the sheer variety of prehistoric creatures to tame is unparalleled, but the game is notoriously dragged down by terrible optimization, massive storage requirements, and a brutal, toxic multiplayer environment for solo players.

PROS:
• Unmatched roster of dinosaurs and mythical creatures to tame, breed, and ride.
• Deep crafting and base-building systems with satisfying progression tiers.
• Epic boss fights and sci-fi lore that keep exploration engaging.
• Massive modding community that adds endless custom maps and features.

CONS:
• Infamously poor optimization, long loading times, and massive file sizes.
• Extremely hostile and toxic public PvP servers that ruthlessly punish solo players.

citations.review_text:
I've spent more than 500 hours in this game between XBox and Steam, and it pains me to write this review as ARK has been one of my favorite games for so long. 

Such a beautiful idea with so poor competitors in the run and the devs still managed to fuck everything. I cannot recommend a game that with all DLC included has more than 400 GB and it's poorly optimized without mentioning the abysmal amount of bugs. And even worse, the last update broke basically everything - just an excuse to move everyone on their new ASA (WHICH I recall it was promised to be free for those who already had bought ASE) 

Seriously, why? The lore behind this game is crazy good and I fell it was forgotten just for the sake of gain most money possible. At this point, I've lost all of my hopes for ARK 2. And it's a shame because the structures of ARK are so good.
The optimization on pc is bad. It weighs too much. The game is good tho one of the best i got

ARK: Survival Evolved features an incredible core concept that is consistently dragged down by its own creators. Taming massive dinosaurs, building beach fortresses, and exploring a beautiful sci-fi prehistoric world provides an absolute blast, especially with a crew. However, the developers constantly sabotage their own success with atrocious optimization, game breaking bugs, and greedy anti consumer decisions like sunsetting original servers to resell the same game back to you.

citations.review_text: Buggy mess! Starts out kind of fun at first then gets too slow and grindy to the point where it becomes less fun. :(

wanted to play this for a long time. since i got it i've had tons of fun in the game, tho i don't really have friends who play it so i am mostly solo (quite sad, hopefully one day). but the process of getting various dinos, flying, running, jumping, and swimming around the map. building new massive basses, and having it all come together is always great for me. modded the game a bit, but even without it it's still quite fun. Yes, all the stuff Snail Games did is.... well, it's not good. but the game itself, ARK, the way WildCard made it.... it's still great. I would still heavily recommend it. especially if you like dinos. and somewhat survival games..... just, uh, dont get surprised by the big grinding sessions you have to do every so often, ok?

(still love flying back to base after harvesting *insert resource name here* with my Argie for an hour or so tho)
